content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(list-partial(@a, @b), Real), $#0 < #1$(a, b), Analysis.contOnIcc(F, a, b), Eq(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), a), Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), b))), Logic.exists-typed(@c, Real, Logic.and(Set.mem(c, Ioo(a, b)), Analysis.deriv(F, c, $0$))))

values.en:
A function continuous on `[a, b]`, differentiable on `(a, b)`, and taking equal values at the endpoints has a stationary point strictly inside.

The proof is the previous two theorems in sequence: extrema are attained by `BasicAnalysis.thm.extremeValue`, and either one is interior — whence `BasicAnalysis.thm.fermat` applies — or both are attained at the endpoints, in which case the function is constant and every interior point works. Note the asymmetry between the closed interval for continuity and the open one for differentiability: it is what lets the theorem apply to `x ↦ √(1 − x²)` on `[−1, 1]`.
values.zh-CN:
若函数在 `[a, b]` 上连续、在 `(a, b)` 上可导，且在两个端点取相等的值，则它在区间内部严格存在一个驻点。

证明依次使用前两个定理：由 `BasicAnalysis.thm.extremeValue`，极值能够取得；若其中一个极值点在内部，则可应用 `BasicAnalysis.thm.fermat`；否则两个极值都在端点取得，此时函数为常数，每个内点都符合要求。注意连续性使用闭区间，而可导性使用开区间，两者具有不对称性：正因如此，该定理才能应用于 `x ↦ √(1 − x²)` 在 `[−1, 1]` 上的情形。
